name: i9_10g_charge
steps: lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) p:queryChargeData(function(code, body) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-charge-query-'..tostring(code)) end if type(body.charges)~='table' then error('vc-charge-array') end if #body.charges~=23 then error('vc-charge-count-'..#body.charges) end for _,row in ipairs(body.charges) do if tonumber(row.charge_count)~=0 or tonumber(row.last_buy_time)~=0 then error('vc-charge-unbought-'..tostring(row.charge_id)) end end xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('vip_recharge',{}) end)
lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('vip_recharge') if not w then error('vc-vip-window') end

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) local intent='vc-card-'..tostring(math.random(1000000000)) xyd.vc_i910g_intent=intent xyd.Backend.get():request(32000,{charge_id=80001001,intent_id=intent},function(code,body) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-tap-card-'..tostring(code)) end local re=body and body.recharge_event if not re or tonumber(re.mid)~=36857 or not re.params then error('vc-tap-card-shape') end if tonumber(re.params.left_card_day)~=30 then error('vc-tap-card-days-'..tostring(re.params.left_card_day)) end xyd.EventDispatcher.get():dispatchEvent({name=xyd.event.RECHARGE,params=re}) end)

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) local intent=xyd.vc_i910g_intent if type(intent)~='string' then error('vc-replay-intent') end xyd.Backend.get():request(32000,{charge_id=80001001,intent_id=intent},function(code,body) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-replay-'..tostring(code)) end local re=body and body.recharge_event if not re or not re.params or tonumber(re.params.left_card_day)~=30 then error('vc-replay-shape') end end)

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) if tonumber(p.leftCardDay)~=30 then error('vc-replay-card-double-'..tostring(p.leftCardDay)) end local intent=xyd.vc_i910g_intent local before=tonumber(p.crystal) xyd.Backend.get():request(32000,{charge_id=80001007,intent_id=intent},function(code,body) if code==xyd.error.OK then error('vc-conflict-admitted') end if not body or tonumber(body.error_code)~=1 then error('vc-conflict-code-'..tostring(body and body.error_code)) end if tonumber(p.crystal)~=before then error('vc-conflict-granted') end end)

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) local before=tonumber(p.crystal) local intent='vc-refuse-'..tostring(math.random(1000000000)) xyd.Backend.get():request(32000,{charge_id=80001028,intent_id=intent},function(code,body) if code==xyd.error.OK then error('vc-refusal-admitted') end if not body or tonumber(body.error_code)~=1 then error('vc-refusal-code-'..tostring(body and body.error_code)) end if tonumber(p.crystal)~=before then error('vc-refusal-granted') end end)

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) local intent='vc-diamond-'..tostring(math.random(1000000000)) xyd.Backend.get():request(32000,{charge_id=80001007,intent_id=intent},function(code,body) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-tap-diamond-'..tostring(code)) end local re=body and body.recharge_event if not re or tonumber(re.mid)~=36857 then error('vc-tap-diamond-shape') end if tonumber(re.params.delta)~=200 then error('vc-tap-diamond-delta-'..tostring(re.params.delta)) end xyd.EventDispatcher.get():dispatchEvent({name=xyd.event.RECHARGE,params=re}) end)

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) if tonumber(p.vip)<1 or tonumber(p.charge)<30 then error('vc-vip-'..tostring(p.vip)..'/'..tostring(p.charge)) end if tonumber(p.crystal)<=0 then error('vc-crystal') end

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) p:queryChargeData(function(code,body) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-charge-reload-'..tostring(code)) end local seen={} for _,row in ipairs(body.charges or {}) do seen[tostring(row.charge_id)]=tonumber(row.charge_count) end if seen['80001001']~=1 or seen['80001007']~=1 then error('vc-charge-history') end end)

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('vip_recharge') if not w or w.middleLev~=1 or not w.middleHelpItem then error('vc-vip-award-stock-page') end local parent=w.middleHelpItem:getChildByName('container') local b=parent:getChildByName('gain_btn') if not b or not b:isVisible() or not b:isTouchEnabled() then error('vc-vip-award-stock-button') end local bind=b.addTouchEventListener local callback b.addTouchEventListener=function(button,handler) callback=handler return bind(button,handler) end w:initVipAwardBtnState(b,1,parent) b.addTouchEventListener=bind if type(callback)~='function' then error('vc-vip-award-stock-handler') end callback(b,ccui.TouchEventType.ended)
lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) if not p.vipAwards or tonumber(p.vipAwards[1])~=1 then error('vc-vip-award-local') end

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.GET_VIP_AWARD,{id=1},function(code,body) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-vip-award-replay-'..tostring(code)) end if type(body.awards)~='table' or #body.awards~=4 then error('vc-vip-award-replay-shape') end end)

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.GET_VIP_AWARD,{id=3},function(code,body) if code==xyd.error.OK then error('vc-vip-award-refuse-admitted') end if not body or tonumber(body.error_code)~=1 then error('vc-vip-award-refuse-code-'..tostring(body and body.error_code)) end end)

lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) if tonumber(p.vip)<1 or tonumber(p.charge)<30 then error('vc-mid1-vip') end if tonumber(p.leftCardDay)~=30 or tonumber(p.monthCardEnd)<=0 or tonumber(p.monthCardStart)<=0 then error('vc-mid1-card-'..tostring(p.leftCardDay)..'/'..tostring(p.monthCardEnd)) end if tonumber(p.leftWeekCardDay)~=0 or tonumber(p.leftEnergyMonthCardDay)~=0 or tonumber(p.privilegeLeftCardDay)~=0 or tonumber(p.privilegeLeftCardEnd)~=0 then error('vc-mid1-zero-cards') end if not p.vipAwards or tonumber(p.vipAwards[1])~=1 then error('vc-mid1-vip-awards') end
note: Month card and diamond buys use the authorized private MID 32000 bridge and stock RECHARGE handling. 354 uses stock queryChargeData. For the first 657 claim the scenario opens the level-1 VIP award page, checks the existing button is visible/enabled, captures its original stock handler during registration through the existing widget binding API, restores that API, then invokes the registered ended callback. This is actual stock callback proof, not physical hit-testing/rendered-phone proof; no copied response handler or assignment of vipAwards/rewards. Additional direct 657 calls test replay/refusal; relogin checks persisted awards/cards.
